title: Enterprise User Experience Leader
description:
**About RedBlack** 




 RedBlack is a leading fintech product company specializing in investment management software. Our platform supports portfolio monitoring, rebalancing, tax optimization, trading, order management, and compliance for wealth management firms. RedBlack supports more than $1 trillion in client assets and is known for accuracy, reliability, and innovation in a highly specialized domain.
 



 We build products for complex, high\-value workflows. For us, UX is not cosmetic. It directly affects advisor productivity, operational confidence, decision quality, and customer trust.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As the
 **Enterprise User Experience Leader (UX Lead)** 
 , you will shape how users understand, navigate, and complete sophisticated investment management workflows. You will work across discovery, problem framing, interaction design, prototyping, validation, specification, and delivery support.
 



 This role is suited for a UX professional who can balance user needs, business rules, data complexity, technical constraints, and delivery realities. You will partner closely with Product, Business Analysis, Engineering, QA, and Delivery to create experiences that are intuitive, consistent, scalable, and enterprise\-grade.
 



 You will not simply produce screens. You will clarify workflows, reduce cognitive load, define reusable interaction patterns, improve design quality, and help teams make better product decisions earlier.
 



  





**Who You Are** 



* You are a product\-minded UX designer who enjoys solving complex workflow problems.
* You bring structure to ambiguity and can move from problem discovery to practical design direction.
* You care deeply about usability, clarity, consistency, accessibility, and enterprise\-grade detail.
* You are comfortable designing for business users, power users, operational teams, and data\-rich environments.
* You communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* You can defend design decisions with evidence, reasoning, user empathy, and business context.
* You collaborate well, accept feedback constructively, and help raise the quality of the team.
* You balance ideal user experience with technical feasibility, timelines, and product priorities.



  





**What you will do** 



* Lead UX discovery for complex product areas by understanding users, workflows, business rules, pain points, and operational context
* Translate complex investment\-management workflows into clear information architecture, task flows, interaction models, and screen designs
* Create wireframes, prototypes, journey maps, user flows, design specifications, and handoff documentation
* Define intuitive experiences for data\-heavy screens, exception handling, multi\-step workflows, dashboards, forms, tables, and decision\-support interfaces
* Partner with Product Owners and Business Analysts to shape requirements, identify UX risks, and improve problem definition before development begins
* Work closely with engineers to ensure design intent is feasible, implemented accurately, and consistent with front\-end standards
* Use design systems, reusable patterns, and component guidance to improve consistency and delivery efficiency
* Apply accessibility, responsive behavior, usability heuristics, and enterprise design best practices to daily design decisions
* Facilitate design reviews, gather feedback, explain design rationale, and align stakeholders around user\-centered solutions
* Support validation through usability review, stakeholder walkthroughs, product demos, user feedback, and iterative refinement
* Mentor designers and help cross\-functional teams build stronger UX judgment and product thinking


- 


**Qualifications** 



* Strong skills in user experience design, including user journey mapping, information architecture, wireframing, and prototyping.
* Experience with user research methods such as interviews, surveys, usability testing, and analysis of behavioral data.
* Proficiency with modern design and collaboration tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar), and familiarity with design systems.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with product, engineering, and business teams, and to present UX concepts and decisions clearly.
* Demonstrated experience leading UX initiatives or teams, with a portfolio showcasing complex, data\-rich applications or fintech products.
* Understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards, and best practices for web\-based enterprise software.
* Excellent problem\-solving, critical thinking, and communication skills, with attention to detail and a user\-centered mindset.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Design, Human\-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.



  





**What Is a Plus** 



* Experience in financial services, wealth management, or investment technology.
* Experience modernizing legacy enterprise interfaces.
* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and modern front\-end frameworks.
* Experience collaborating in a fast\-paced, iterative product environment.



  





**Why Join RedBlack** 



* Shape UX for a sophisticated fintech platform used in high\-value investment management workflows.
* Work on meaningful enterprise product problems where design quality has direct business impact.
* Collaborate with teams that value thoughtful execution, ownership, and product excellence.
* Influence design standards, workflow clarity, and user experience maturity across the platform.
* Benefit from hybrid work, flexible hours, competitive compensation, and a high\-quality office environment.



  





**Contact Recruitment Team:** 
 recruitment\-india@redblacksoftware.com

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 Develop visual designs that communicate ideas effectively across digital and marketing channels. The Graphic Designer will work on a variety of creative requirements, including social media posts, promotional materials, website graphics, presentations, and brand assets. The role involves understanding design briefs, developing suitable concepts, refining visuals based on feedback, and ensuring that final designs meet quality and brand standards. Strong creative thinking, visual awareness, attention to detail, and the ability to work within deadlines are essential for this position.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Create creative designs for social media posts, digital campaigns, websites, advertisements, and marketing materials
* Translate concepts and content briefs into visually appealing design layouts
* Develop banners, brochures, presentations, and other communication materials
* Work closely with content, marketing, and creative teams to understand design requirements
* Select suitable typography, imagery, layouts, and visual elements for different design projects
* Resize and adapt creative assets according to the requirements of different platforms
* Review completed designs, incorporate feedback, and make necessary revisions
* Organise and maintain design files, source materials, and final creative assets


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia, Fine Arts, or a related field
* Minimum 1 year of professional experience in graphic design or a related creative role
* Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and other relevant graphic design tools
* Strong understanding of typography, composition, colour, spacing, and visual balance
* Good creative thinking and visual communication skills
